data.content:
### Galatasaray

Abdulkerim Bardakci will miss the match through suspension, which will lead to changes in central defence. There are no other absentees, but there could be rotation among those who started the Champions League match.

### Amedspor

Samuel Ballet will not be available for the team in Istanbul. He was sent off in the previous round. Muhammed Hasan Yıldırım and Dilhan Demir remain on the list of unavailable players.
